name: D03_gold_frequency
motion_prompt: Locked camera on a single sculptural liquid-gold waveform suspended against pure black. Smooth traveling waves ripple through the ribbon from left to right. The peaks rise and fall rhythmically while long continuous specular highlights roll over the polished metal. A hypnotic repeating wave cycle returns to its initial form. The ribbon remains one coherent connected sculpture, all motion contained within the panoramic frame. Sophisticated hip-hop concert visual, steady exposure, fluid motion, no cuts, no camera motion.
processing: Wan 2.2 first/last frame, 81 frames at 16 fps; crop 2 px top/bottom; optical-flow interpolation to 60 fps; cosine time remap forward then reverse over one 8-second cycle, delivered at 30 fps. Eased reversals avoid a hard cut or a tail-to-head dissolve. ProRes LT master and all-intra H.264 delivery.
